'''2000 Ralltiir Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional championship for the Ralltiir region (Austria, Germany, Switzerland) in the 2000 Decipher championship circuit.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="rl00ralltiir">[http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=ralltiir 2000 Regionals: Ralltiir], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010727140302/http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=ralltiir Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Martin Falke]] of Bochum, Germany won and qualified for the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional championship
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 5 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Kulturzentrum Herne-Mitte Feen-Con Herne, Germany
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Winfried Sommerfeld]]
